body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Expanding its breadth of AQUOS LED LCD TV offerings, Sharp introduced three new small-screen models with a contemporary, ultra-thin design and high-quality performance during Sharp press conference at CES 2010.

Available in 32- (31 1/2 diagonal) and 22-inch (21 1/2 diagonal) screen class sizes, the LS510 series (models LC-32LS510UT and LC-22LS510UT) delivers stunning Full HD 1080p imagery in a space-saving footprint. The 19-inch (18 1/2 diagonal) screen class size LC-19LS410UT rounds out Sharp's line of LED LCD TVs for any room or need.

Employing a high-performance TFT LCD panel with Spectral Contrast Engine UD, these models, combined with an edge-lit LED backlight system, provide high contrast ratios for deep blacks and vibrant colors in dark or bright scenes.

The LS510 and LS410 series tout a contemporary AQUOS edge design, in which the panel glass extends to the edge of the frame. With an ultra-thin depth of only 1.49 inches, these units offer ultimate placement flexibility.
